verdict.rationale: Spline has a built-in AI Agent, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, every MCP mention in the evidence describes the server role. The desktop app bundles a Spline MCP Server so that external clients (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) can drive the editor. Nothing shows Spline's own agent connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers.
